notes.title: Erocism has been updated
notes.notes:
Hello,
This is Momentum Games.

Thank you so much for playing our game.

We are continuously striving to create enjoyable games.

I'm reading all the reviews you guys leave and I'm correcting the parts that I can fix.

We are very grateful and would like to inform you of today’s update details.

Ending Story Addition
- It's not a complete ending story.
After that, think of it as a link to what kind of story it will lead to.
- Even those who have cleared all stages can immediately see the ending story by pressing the continue button.

Added Skill Button Hotkey
- By default, it is set to the Space key, and you can change the shortcut in the settings.

Fixed Chinese Errors
- Corrected the different settings between Simplified and Traditional Chinese.

Fixed Costume Bug in H SCENE
- Fixed the bug where pressing the costume button had no response.

Fixed Achievement Bug
- Fixed the bug where the "Professional Erocist" achievement could not be obtained.

Help Section Fixes
- Adjusted the help images that changed sizes based on resolution.

We hope you continue to enjoy playing our game!

notes.title: "Erocism" has been updated
notes.notes:
Hello.
This is Momentum Games.

When it comes to playing the game, I hear that there are users who are having a hard time clearing puzzles,
I've added the ability to skip puzzles in a hurry!

Now you can enjoy the game without a puzzle blocking you from proceeding!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45032004/78d13c1175a3bb1176e6e31a279dd6423be30971.png[/img]
(When the button is pressed, the stage is cleared immediately.)

However, if you skip, it will be cleared as 1~2 star, so if you enjoy the puzzle, please aim for 3 stars!

Other updates include.

1. Modifying dialogue script hero
- Modify the part of the conversation script that was marked "hero" to appear as the nickname you set

2. Audio problems
- Remove and modify some of the player character fx
- The bug that initializes when the volume value set in the settings reconnection
- Change button sound

4. Correction of lag during the H-Scene "Rokurokubi" process

5. Fix the effect bug when selecting a stage

Then I hope you continue to have fun playing the game!

notes.title: "Erocism" has been released.
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45032004/e6fca565ebab084cd4dcf1a690bd3ee9bdee5144.jpg[/img]
Hello,

We are pleased to share some exciting news with you today.

Our long-awaited game, Erocism, has finally been released!

As the third game among the five new titles from Momentum Games, Erocism is a tantalizing exorcism adventure featuring a male protagonist and his dog, Biggie Dicky.

Do you believe in the existence of ghosts?

Globally renowned ghosts possess powerful abilities and can possess humans, throwing the world into chaos. Their immense power makes exorcism nearly impossible, leaving no choice but to seal the possessed individuals within a book called the "Book of Seals."

For unknown reasons, the protagonist and Biggie Dicky come into possession of the "Book of Seals," and the ensuing titillating exorcisms unfold from there. Are you ready to witness these thrilling adventures?

To celebrate the release, we are offering a 10% discount, so we hope you'll download the game and enjoy it. We will return soon with updates and more exciting news.

Thank you.
The Momentum Games Team
